newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end higher awaiting FOMC, Bundesbank.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end higher awaiting FOMC, Bundesbank.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Swiss bonds ended higher on Monday in quiet trade before the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on Tuesday and the Bundesbank council meeting Thursday.
* Sept Conf futures up 17 basis points at 119.97
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yields 3.49 pct vs 3.502 pct
